name: RÉCOR BODS v0.4 export profile
certification: None. This profile is self-declared by SIGIL SARL and has not been certified or validated by any third party.

exportFormat.serialization: JSON Lines (one BODS statement per line)
exportFormat.integrityEnvelope: Designed to ship as a bundle: the statement stream, a manifest carrying a BLAKE3 digest of the stream, and an Ed25519 signature over the manifest.

statementMapping.recorSource: The company named in an accepted declaration: legal name, jurisdiction, registrar identifier, founding date.
statementMapping.notes: The profile currently targets registered entities (registeredEntity).

statementMapping.recorSource: Each natural person identified as a beneficial owner: name and, where recorded, nationality.
statementMapping.notes: Public-tier exports are designed to omit date of birth, place of birth, tax residencies, and national identity-document identifiers.

statementMapping.recorSource: The declared ownership-or-control interest linking person to company: interest type, share as a percentage range, start date.
statementMapping.cardinality: one per beneficial owner per company
statementMapping.notes: Interest types are drawn from the BODS v0.4 interest-type codelist; full alignment of the vocabulary is a design target of this profile.

identifiers: Statement identifiers are minted deterministically from the underlying record and declaration identifiers; re-exporting the same declaration is designed to yield identical identifiers so consumers can deduplicate.
inclusionRule: Only declarations that have completed RÉCOR's nine-stage verification pipeline and been accepted are designed to be included; a rejected declaration is designed never to appear in a public export.

extensions.description: Namespaced fields designed to carry a pointer into RÉCOR's triple-witnessed, Merkle-anchored audit chain, the source-declaration reference, and the disclosure tier, so a consumer holding only a statement can trace it back to its audit record.

notes: This is a self-declared conformance profile describing intended mappings. It is not a third-party certification.
RÉCOR is pre-deployment; no live deployment has produced the exports this profile describes.
RÉCOR was fully demonstrated to, and acknowledged by, Open Ownership on 1 July 2026. This is a technical demonstration, not an endorsement.
Where the standard and the implementation could diverge, the standard wins and the profile is corrected.
Versions are append-only: a correction or a future BODS release is published as a new, dated profile version alongside this one.
